verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party capability to export all account or workspace data (deployments, checkpoints, logs, usage) in open formats. Nearby items do not count toward this story: the open-source Truss packaging, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, checkpoints synced to platform storage, and migrating deprecated Model API weights to a dedicated deployment are portability-adjacent features, not a data-export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
